subject: general
question:
Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

5, 12, 19, 26, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:-

We add 7 in the first number and get second number, then we add 7 in second number we get third number and so on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb58d28dc5ebffa559f3a7eaa1c1f8898dd3e636804e74f3e37caea6012dd0f3.png] 

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
